title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A1–B1）
section: 第 201–250 個單字（CEFR A1 基礎入門）

examples.en: My wallet is in the backpack.
examples.zh: 我的皮夾在背包裡面。

examples.en: We study in the classroom every weekday morning.
examples.zh: 我們每個平日早晨都在教室裡學習。

examples.en: She was born in Taichung in 2008.
examples.zh: 她於 2008 年在台中出生。

examples.en: Place the computer on the desk.
examples.zh: 把電腦放在書桌上。

examples.en: There is a picture hanging on the wall.
examples.zh: 牆上掛著一幅畫。

examples.en: What channel is the baseball game on tonight?
examples.zh: 今晚棒球比賽在第幾台播出？

examples.en: The cat is sleeping under the table.
examples.zh: 貓咪正在桌子底下睡覺。

examples.en: We stood under the big tree to avoid the sudden rain.
examples.zh: 我們站在大樹下躲避突如其來的陣雨。

examples.en: Keep everything under control during the experiment.
examples.zh: 實驗過程中要讓一切保持受控。

examples.en: The bookstore is next to the post office.
examples.zh: 書店就在郵局隔壁。

examples.en: May I sit next to you on the school bus?
examples.zh: 我可以坐在校車上你旁邊的位置嗎？

examples.en: Place the dictionary right next to your study notebook.
examples.zh: 把字典放在你研讀筆記本的正旁邊。

examples.en: Who is standing behind the curtain?
examples.zh: 誰站在窗簾後面？

examples.en: The playground is located behind the gymnasium.
examples.zh: 遊樂場位於體育館後方。

examples.en: Don't leave your personal belongings behind when you leave.
examples.zh: 離開時不要遺落你的個人隨身物品。

examples.en: There is a big tree in front of our house.
examples.zh: 我們房子前面有一棵大樹。

examples.en: The teacher stood in front of the chalkboard and began teaching.
examples.zh: 老師站在黑板前開始講課。

examples.en: Please wait for me in front of the MRT exit number two.
examples.zh: 請在捷運二號出口前等我。

examples.en: Do you live near the MRT station?
examples.zh: 你住在捷運站附近嗎？

examples.en: There is a convenient grocery store near our school gate.
examples.zh: 我們學校校門口附近有一家方便的雜貨店。

examples.en: Winter vacation is drawing near as January approaches.
examples.zh: 隨著一月份臨近，寒假也越來越近了。

examples.en: The convenience store is between the bank and the clinic.
examples.zh: 便利商店在銀行與診所之間。

examples.en: What is the main difference between these two grammar rules?
examples.zh: 這兩條文法規則之間的主要差異是什麼？

examples.en: Keep this secret strictly between you and me.
examples.zh: 請把這個秘密嚴格保留在你我之間。

examples.en: Please sign your name right here.
examples.zh: 請就在這裡簽名。

examples.en: Here is the library book that you wanted to borrow.
examples.zh: 這是你想借閱的圖書館書籍。

examples.en: Spring has arrived, and warm weather is finally here.
examples.zh: 春天到了，溫暖的天氣終於來臨了。

examples.en: There is a new bakery over there.
examples.zh: 那裡開了一家新的麵包店。

examples.en: Are there any seats left on the evening bullet train?
examples.zh: 晚班高鐵還有剩餘座位嗎？

examples.en: Put your heavy backpack over there by the classroom door.
examples.zh: 把你的重背包放在教室門口那邊。

examples.en: They bought a lovely house in Yilan.
examples.zh: 他們在宜蘭買了一棟可愛的房子。

examples.en: This museum houses thousands of ancient historical relics.
examples.zh: 這座博物館收藏了數千件古老的歷史文物。

examples.en: We had a lively housewarming party with our new neighbors.
examples.zh: 我們和新鄰居們舉辦了一場熱鬧的喬遷派對。

examples.en: Welcome home! Dinner is ready.
examples.zh: 歡迎回家！晚餐準備好了。

examples.en: I usually stay at home and relax on Sunday afternoons.
examples.zh: 星期天下午我通常待在家裡放鬆。

examples.en: Taiwan is home to many unique endemic animal species.
examples.zh: 台灣是許多獨特特有種動物的家園。

examples.en: Dad is making soup in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 爸爸正在廚房煮湯。

examples.en: Wipe the kitchen counter clean after cooking meals.
examples.zh: 做完飯後請把廚房流理台擦拭乾淨。

examples.en: Delicious baking smells drifted out from the kitchen.
examples.zh: 廚房裡飄出了誘人的烘焙香氣。

examples.en: May I use your bathroom, please?
examples.zh: 請問我可以借用一下洗手間嗎？

examples.en: Remember to wash your hands with soap in the bathroom.
examples.zh: 記得在洗手間用肥皂把手洗乾淨。

examples.en: The hotel room includes a modern, spotless private bathroom.
examples.zh: 飯店房間內設有一間現代化且一塵不染的私人浴室。

examples.en: My grandma grows roses in her garden.
examples.zh: 我奶奶在她的花園裡種玫瑰花。

examples.en: We sat in the rooftop garden enjoying the gentle breeze.
examples.zh: 我們坐在頂樓花園享受著徐徐微風。

examples.en: She loves to garden during her free time on weekends.
examples.zh: 週末有空時她很喜歡從事園藝。

examples.en: Many people jog in Daan Forest Park.
examples.zh: 許多人在大安森林公園慢跑。

examples.en: You cannot park your car in front of the emergency exit.
examples.zh: 你不能把車停在緊急出口前。

examples.en: Children laughed and played on the park swings.
examples.zh: 孩子們在公園鞦韆上歡笑玩耍。

examples.en: Let's drop by the convenience store.
examples.zh: 我們順道去一趟便利商店吧。

examples.en: You should store fresh milk in the refrigerator.
examples.zh: 你應該把鮮奶存放在冰箱裡。

examples.en: The department store is holding an annual anniversary sale.
examples.zh: 這家百貨公司正在舉辦一年一度的週年慶。

examples.en: You must remain quiet in the library.
examples.zh: 在圖書館內必須保持安靜。

examples.en: I borrowed three English storybooks from the municipal library.
examples.zh: 我從市立圖書館借了三本英文故事書。

examples.en: The university library stays open late during exam week.
examples.zh: 大學圖書館在考試週期間會延長開放至深夜。

examples.en: I need to withdraw some cash from the bank.
examples.zh: 我需要從銀行領一些現金。

examples.en: We sat on the grassy river bank and watched the sunset.
examples.zh: 我們坐在青草叢生的河岸邊欣賞夕陽。

examples.en: She opened a savings account at the post bank yesterday.
examples.zh: 她昨天在郵局銀行開立了一個儲蓄帳戶。

examples.en: I need to send this parcel at the post office.
examples.zh: 我需要去郵局寄這個包裹。

examples.en: The post office closes at five o'clock in the afternoon.
examples.zh: 郵局在下午五點整關門。

examples.en: You can buy commemorative stamps at the central post office.
examples.zh: 你可以在總郵局購買紀念郵票。

examples.en: Dogs are loyal human companions.
examples.zh: 狗是人類忠實的伴侶。

examples.en: I take my pet dog for a twenty-minute walk every evening.
examples.zh: 我每天傍晚帶我的寵物狗去散步二十分鐘。

examples.en: The friendly golden retriever wagged its tail happily.
examples.zh: 那隻友善的黃金獵犬高興地搖著尾巴。

examples.en: The black cat is resting on the windowsill.
examples.zh: 那隻黑貓正趴在窗台上休息。

examples.en: My cat purrs softly whenever I gently stroke its fur.
examples.zh: 每當我輕撫我家的貓咪時，牠便發出輕柔的呼嚕聲。

examples.en: Stray cats in the neighborhood are fed by kind residents.
examples.zh: 社區裡的流浪貓受到好心居民的餵食照顧。

examples.en: The early bird catches the worm.
examples.zh: 早起的鳥兒有蟲吃。

examples.en: Flocks of migratory birds visit the river wetlands every winter.
examples.zh: 每年冬天成群的候鳥都會造訪河口濕地。

examples.en: We woke up to the cheerful chirping of wild birds.
examples.zh: 我們在野鳥歡快的鳴囀聲中醒來。

examples.en: Pigs are actually very smart animals.
examples.zh: 豬其實是非常聰明的動物。

examples.en: The farmer feeds the mother pig fresh vegetables and corn.
examples.zh: 農夫用新鮮蔬菜和玉米餵養母豬。

examples.en: He has been collecting coins in his ceramic piggy bank for a year.
examples.zh: 他把硬幣存在他的陶瓷小豬撲滿裡已經一年了。

examples.en: Cows provide us with fresh milk.
examples.zh: 乳牛為我們提供新鮮的牛奶。

examples.en: Dairy cows grazed peacefully in the lush green pasture.
examples.zh: 乳牛在翠綠茂盛的牧場上悠閒地吃草。

examples.en: Holy cow, look at the size of that giant watermelon!
examples.zh: 我的天哪，快看那顆巨型西瓜有多大！

examples.en: Roast duck is a famous Chinese delicacy.
examples.zh: 烤鴨是著名的中華美食。

examples.en: Several yellow ducklings swam gracefully behind their mother.
examples.zh: 幾隻黃色小鴨優雅地游在鴨媽媽身後。

examples.en: Duck your head when entering this low-ceiling cave.
examples.zh: 走進這座低矮洞穴時請低頭彎腰。

examples.en: She loves to ride horses on weekends.
examples.zh: 她喜歡在週末騎馬。

examples.en: The brown horse galloped swiftly across the wide field.
examples.zh: 棕色的馬在廣闊的田野上疾速奔馳。

examples.en: That unexpected candidate proved to be a dark horse in the race.
examples.zh: 那位出乎意料的候選人證實是這場競賽中的黑馬。

examples.en: You can see Formosan rock macaques on Shoushan.
examples.zh: 你可以在壽山上看到台灣獼猴。

examples.en: Stop monkeying around and finish your homework first.
examples.zh: 別再胡鬧搗蛋了，先把作業寫完。

examples.en: The clever monkey peeled the sweet banana effortlessly.
examples.zh: 聰明的猴子毫不費力地剝開了香甜的香蕉。

examples.en: The Formosan black bear is a protected animal.
examples.zh: 台灣黑熊是保育類動物。

examples.en: I cannot bear the scorching heat in midsummer without air conditioning.
examples.zh: 盛夏沒有冷氣我實在無法忍受那股酷熱。

examples.en: A polar bear has thick fur to stay warm in the Arctic snow.
examples.zh: 北極熊擁有厚實的毛皮，能在北極風雪中保持溫暖。

examples.en: The lion is often called the king of the jungle.
examples.zh: 獅子常被稱為萬獸之王。

examples.en: A pride of lions rested quietly under the shade of an acacia tree.
examples.zh: 一群獅子在金合歡樹蔭下安靜休息。

examples.en: He showed lionhearted courage when facing the sudden emergency.
examples.zh: 面對突如其來的緊急狀況，他展現了雄獅般的勇氣。

examples.en: Tigers have orange fur with black stripes.
examples.zh: 老虎有著帶黑條紋的橘色毛皮。

examples.en: Bengal tigers are known for their strength and solitary lifestyle.
examples.zh: 孟加拉虎以其力量和獨居習性而聞名。

examples.en: That strict warning turned out to be nothing more than a paper tiger.
examples.zh: 那個嚴格的警告結果只不過是一隻紙老虎。

examples.en: Elephants have very long trunks and big ears.
examples.zh: 大象有著長長的鼻子和大大的耳朵。

examples.en: An Asian elephant can live for more than sixty years.
examples.zh: 亞洲象可以存活超過六十年。

examples.en: Let's address the elephant in the room and discuss the budget problem.
examples.zh: 我們來正視這個大家心照不宣卻避而不談的預算問題吧。

examples.en: Look at the beautiful rainbow in the sky!
examples.zh: 快看天上美麗的彩虹！

examples.en: She looks very elegant in her traditional festival costume.
examples.zh: 她穿著傳統節慶服裝看起來十分優雅。

examples.en: Can you help me look for my lost bus card?
examples.zh: 你能幫我找一下我遺失的公車卡嗎？

examples.en: I see what you mean.
examples.zh: 我明白你的意思了。

examples.en: Let me see the test results before we celebrate.
examples.zh: 在我們慶祝之前，先讓我看一下考試成果。

examples.en: It was so foggy that we could hardly see the road ahead.
examples.zh: 霧太濃了，以致於我們幾乎看不見前方的道路。

examples.en: Please listen carefully to the instructions.
examples.zh: 請仔細聆聽說明。

examples.en: I like to listen to classical piano music while studying.
examples.zh: 讀書時我喜歡聽古典鋼琴音樂。

examples.en: You should always listen to your parents' sincere advice.
examples.zh: 你應該始終傾聽父母誠懇的建議。

examples.en: Did you hear that strange sound?
examples.zh: 你有聽見那個奇怪的聲音嗎？

examples.en: I haven't heard from my elementary school classmate for years.
examples.zh: 我已經多年沒有收到國小同班同學的音訊了。

examples.en: Speak louder so that the students in the back can hear you clearly.
examples.zh: 講大聲一點，好讓後排的學生能聽得清楚。

examples.en: Can you speak English and Mandarin?
examples.zh: 你會說英文和國語嗎？

examples.en: Actions speak much louder than words.
examples.zh: 行動勝於空談。

examples.en: She was invited to speak at the international youth forum.
examples.zh: 她受邀在國際青年論壇上發表演說。

examples.en: Let's talk about our weekend plans.
examples.zh: 我們來聊聊週末的計畫吧。

examples.en: We had a long heart-to-heart talk about our future dreams.
examples.zh: 我們針對未來的夢想進行了一次長談交心。

examples.en: Don't talk during the movie screening in the cinema.
examples.zh: 電影院放映期間請不要說話。

examples.en: What did the teacher say about the test?
examples.zh: 老師說了什麼關於考試的事？

examples.en: Remember to say thank you whenever someone assists you.
examples.zh: 每當有人協助你時，記得說聲謝謝。

examples.en: It goes without saying that health is more valuable than money.
examples.zh: 不用說，健康自然比金錢更加珍貴。

examples.en: Can you tell me the way to the station?
examples.zh: 你能告訴我往車站怎麼走嗎？

examples.en: Grandfather loves to tell fascinating folk stories by the fireplace.
examples.zh: 爺爺喜歡在壁爐旁講述迷人的民間傳說。

examples.en: It is always best to tell the truth even when it is difficult.
examples.zh: 即使困難重重，說實話永遠是最好的選擇。

examples.en: I love to read English novels before bed.
examples.zh: 我喜歡在睡前閱讀英文小說。

examples.en: The teacher asked the students to read the dialogue aloud.
examples.zh: 老師要求學生們大聲朗讀這段對話。

examples.en: I read an inspiring article about marine conservation in today's paper.
examples.zh: 我在今天的報紙上讀到了一篇關於海洋保育的鼓舞人心的文章。

examples.en: Please write down your email address.
examples.zh: 請寫下你的電子郵件地址。

examples.en: She writes in her personal diary every night before going to sleep.
examples.zh: 她每晚睡前都會在私人日記裡寫下記錄。

examples.en: He decided to write a thank-you letter to his former tutor.
examples.zh: 他決定寫一封感謝信給他以前的家教老師。

examples.en: Children like to draw pictures with crayons.
examples.zh: 小朋友喜歡用蠟筆畫畫。

examples.en: The street magician drew a huge crowd of curious spectators.
examples.zh: 街頭魔術師吸引了一大群好奇的圍觀群眾。

examples.en: The thrilling basketball championship game ended in a draw.
examples.zh: 這場精彩刺激的籃球冠軍賽以平手收場。

examples.en: The supermarket is open 24 hours a day.
examples.zh: 這家超市一天 24 小時營業。

examples.en: Please open the front window to let fresh air circulate.
examples.zh: 請打開前窗讓新鮮空氣流通。

examples.en: The new library branch will open to the public next Monday.
examples.zh: 新的圖書館分館將於下週一對公眾開放。

examples.en: Please close the window before you leave.
examples.zh: 離開前請把窗戶關上。

examples.en: Amy and Emily have been close friends since elementary school.
examples.zh: 艾咪和艾蜜莉從小學起就是親密好友。

examples.en: The local clinic closes at eight o'clock in the evening.
examples.zh: 在地診所在晚間八點整結束看診。

examples.en: Give me a hand with these heavy boxes.
examples.zh: 幫我搬一下這些重箱子吧。

examples.en: She gave her younger brother an inspiring storybook for his birthday.
examples.zh: 她送給弟弟一本充滿啟發性的故事書作為生日禮物。

examples.en: Never give up on your dreams no matter how tough things get.
examples.zh: 無論處境多麼艱難，絕不要放棄你的夢想。

examples.en: It will take fifteen minutes to get there.
examples.zh: 到那裡需要花費十五分鐘。

examples.en: We took lots of wonderful photos during our hike in Taroko Gorge.
examples.zh: 我們在太魯閣峽谷健行時拍了許多精彩照片。

examples.en: Remember to take your prescribed medicine after each meal.
examples.zh: 記得三餐飯後服用醫師開立的處方藥。

examples.en: Don't forget to bring your textbook tomorrow.
examples.zh: 明天別忘了帶你的課本來。

examples.en: The spring rain brings green life back to dry mountain hills.
examples.zh: 春雨讓乾燥的山丘重現翠綠生機。

examples.en: You can bring a friend along to our weekend study session.
examples.zh: 你可以帶一位朋友一起參加我們週末的讀書會。

examples.en: I cannot find my student ID card anywhere.
examples.zh: 我到處都找不到我的學生證。

examples.en: Scientists hope to find new renewable energy solutions.
examples.zh: 科學家希望能找到新的再生能源解決方案。

examples.en: Did you find it easy to adapt to the new school routine?
examples.zh: 你覺得適應新的學校日常步調容易嗎？

examples.en: Thank you so much for your kind help!
examples.zh: 非常感謝你的熱心幫忙！

examples.en: Eating fresh fruits can help strengthen your immune system.
examples.zh: 多吃新鮮水果能有助於強化你的免疫系統。

examples.en: Don't hesitate to ask for help if you encounter any difficulties.
examples.zh: 如果遇到任何困難，請毫不猶豫地尋求協助。
